# conditions of access

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:conditionsOfAccess`](gmeow-conditionsOfAccess.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry free-text conditions under which an asset may be accessed ([schema:conditionsOfAccess](https://schema.org/conditionsOfAccess)) — on-site only, by appointment, embargoed until a date.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating access conditions with reuse licence terms (those are [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md) and the rule layer) and avoid using it for the free/paid signal, which is [`gmeow:isAccessibleForFree`](gmeow-isAccessibleForFree.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:conditionsOfAccess`](gmeow-conditionsOfAccess.md) on the asset for prose access constraints; where access is a regulated action, also model it as a rule over a [`gmeow:RightsAction`](../classes/gmeow-RightsAction.md).

### Examples

- ex:archiveItem [`gmeow:conditionsOfAccess`](gmeow-conditionsOfAccess.md) "On-site access only; by appointment.".
